name: VHDL
designers: US Department of Defense VHSIC programme (Intermetrics, IBM, Texas Instruments)
summary: Ada-derived hardware description language created for the US DoD VHSIC programme and standardised as IEEE 1076 (1987, 1993, 2000, 2002, 2008, 2019). Describes hardware as entities/architectures with concurrent processes communicating through signals under a delta-cycle simulation model, with strong typing, packages, generics and configurations.

level_notes.1: The Language Reference Manual (IEEE 1076-2019) is paywalled. Linked instead: the IEEE standard page, the P1076 working group site with the VHDL-2019 change list, the Hamburg BNF of VHDL-93 (derived from the LRM), and the open-source IEEE standard packages published by the working group.
level_notes.0: Open-source implementations: GHDL (Ada; LLVM/GCC/mcode back ends, also synthesis via ghdl-yosys-plugin) and nvc (C, LLVM JIT). The IEEE packages (std_logic_1164, numeric_std, textio...) are published by P1076 under Apache-2.0.
